data.long_meaning: Mawia is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'Moon Goddess'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is a symbol of fertility, power, and nourishment. Mawia is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl. The name Mawia carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mawia usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Mawia signifies the eternal power and nourishment of the Moon Goddess. It is believed that the Moon Goddess protects, guides, and influences the emotional, intuitive, and feminine aspects of life.
